title: Edit event
ownerNotice: You created this event with your account, so you can manage it without an edit key.

toast.reenterKey: Please enter the edit key again

keyModal.title: Enter the edit key
keyModal.description: To edit this event, enter the edit key that was set (or issued) when the event was created.
keyModal.label: Edit key
keyModal.helper: You stay signed in until you close this tab

info.title: Event details
info.name: Event name
info.deadlinePast: The deadline must be in the future

candidates.title: Candidate dates
candidates.minOne: At least one candidate date is required
candidates.endAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time
candidates.confirmBody: This date has {count} responses. Deleting it will also delete those answers.

closing.title: Closing responses
closing.expired: The response deadline has passed. Extend the deadline to accept responses again.
closing.help: Once closed, nobody can add or change responses. You can reopen at any time.
closing.expiredNote: The deadline has also passed, so extend it if you want people to respond after reopening.
closing.finalized: The date has been decided, so responses can't be closed or reopened. Undo the decision to change this.

finalize.title: Decide the date
finalize.help: Choose the date to decide on. Responses will be closed once the date is decided.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.help: Deleting the event permanently removes all candidate dates and responses. This can't be undone.
danger.confirmBody: "{name}" and its {count} responses will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
